title: Meet Vortex
items: Open Vortex below Help in Vision, or above the server-storage footer in Venture.
Find and download public media with your existing account. Accepted downloads continue on FUPCJ Server when you leave.
Return to view progress, save a completed file, or cancel and delete items. Files expire five days after completion.
Vortex requires the matching Windows processor update. Gallery and Spotify support use the optional Vortex tools installer.
